01_portfolio:
-- GRAIN CONTRACT: one row per borrower before aggregation.
WITH ranked_features AS (
  SELECT borrower_id, exposure, utilization, debt_service_ratio,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY borrower_id ORDER BY borrower_id) AS rn
  FROM borrower_features
),
borrower_grain AS (
  SELECT borrower_id, exposure, utilization, debt_service_ratio
  FROM ranked_features
  WHERE rn=1
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS borrowers,
       ROUND(SUM(exposure),2) AS exposure_egp,
       ROUND(AVG(utilization),4) AS mean_utilization,
       ROUND(AVG(debt_service_ratio),4) AS mean_debt_service_ratio
FROM borrower_grain;
02_delinquency_trend:
-- GRAIN CONTRACT: one account-month row; historical cutoff applied before aggregation.
WITH ranked_snapshots AS (
  SELECT account_id, month_end, balance, dpd,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY account_id,month_end ORDER BY account_id) AS rn
  FROM monthly_snapshots
  WHERE month_end<='2025-12-31'
),
account_month AS (
  SELECT account_id,month_end,balance,dpd FROM ranked_snapshots WHERE rn=1
)
SELECT month_end,COUNT(*) AS accounts,
       SUM(CASE WHEN dpd>=30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS late_accounts,
       ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN dpd>=30 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END),5) AS late_rate,
       ROUND(SUM(balance),2) AS exposure_egp
FROM account_month
GROUP BY month_end
ORDER BY month_end;
03_utilization_segments:
WITH segments AS (
 SELECT f.borrower_id, f.exposure,o.bad_6m,
 CASE WHEN f.utilization<0.3 THEN '01 Under 30%'
 WHEN f.utilization<0.6 THEN '02 30-60%'
 WHEN f.utilization<0.9 THEN '03 60-90%'
 ELSE '04 90% or more' END AS segment
 FROM borrower_features f JOIN borrower_outcomes o USING(borrower_id)
)
SELECT segment,COUNT(*) AS borrowers,SUM(bad_6m) AS events,
 ROUND(AVG(bad_6m),5) AS observed_rate,ROUND(SUM(exposure),2) AS exposure_egp
FROM segments GROUP BY segment ORDER BY segment;
04_roll_rates:
-- Adjacent account-month transitions. LAG is partitioned by account, not borrower.
WITH bands AS (
 SELECT account_id,month_end,
 CASE WHEN dpd=0 THEN 'Current' WHEN dpd<30 THEN '01-29'
 WHEN dpd<60 THEN '30-59' ELSE '60+' END AS band
 FROM monthly_snapshots WHERE month_end <= '2025-12-31'
), transitions AS (
 SELECT *,LAG(band) OVER(PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY month_end) AS previous_band
 FROM bands
), counts AS (
 SELECT previous_band,band,COUNT(*) AS transitions FROM transitions
 WHERE previous_band IS NOT NULL GROUP BY previous_band,band
)
SELECT *,ROUND(1.0*transitions/SUM(transitions) OVER(PARTITION BY previous_band),5) AS transition_rate
FROM counts ORDER BY previous_band,band;
05_test_deciles:
-- Evaluation only: highest estimated event probability first.
WITH ranked AS (
 SELECT *,NTILE(10) OVER(ORDER BY pd DESC,borrower_id) AS risk_decile
 FROM predictions WHERE split='test'
)
SELECT risk_decile,COUNT(*) AS borrowers,SUM(bad_6m) AS events,
 ROUND(AVG(pd),5) AS predicted_rate,ROUND(AVG(bad_6m),5) AS observed_rate
FROM ranked GROUP BY risk_decile ORDER BY risk_decile;
06_test_calibration:
-- GRAIN CONTRACT: one held-out prediction per borrower before probability binning.
WITH ranked_predictions AS (
  SELECT borrower_id,pd,bad_6m,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY split,borrower_id ORDER BY borrower_id) AS rn
  FROM predictions
  WHERE split='test'
),
test_base AS (
  SELECT borrower_id,pd,bad_6m FROM ranked_predictions WHERE rn=1
),
binned AS (
  SELECT borrower_id,pd,bad_6m,MIN(9,CAST(pd*10 AS INTEGER)) AS probability_bin
  FROM test_base
)
SELECT probability_bin,COUNT(*) AS borrowers,
       ROUND(AVG(pd),5) AS predicted_rate,
       ROUND(AVG(bad_6m),5) AS observed_rate
FROM binned
GROUP BY probability_bin
ORDER BY probability_bin;
07_product_mix:
-- FAN-OUT CONTROL: deduplicate account dimension and selected month-end snapshot before joining.
WITH account_ranked AS (
  SELECT account_id,product,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY account_id) AS rn
  FROM accounts
),
snapshot_ranked AS (
  SELECT account_id,balance,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY account_id,month_end ORDER BY account_id) AS rn
  FROM monthly_snapshots
  WHERE month_end='2025-12-31'
),
account_dim AS (
  SELECT account_id,product FROM account_ranked WHERE rn=1
),
month_end_balance AS (
  SELECT account_id,balance FROM snapshot_ranked WHERE rn=1
)
SELECT a.product,COUNT(*) AS accounts,ROUND(SUM(m.balance),2) AS exposure_egp
FROM account_dim a
JOIN month_end_balance m ON m.account_id=a.account_id
GROUP BY a.product
ORDER BY a.product;
08_history_segments:
-- FAN-OUT CONTROL: reduce feature and outcome inputs to borrower grain independently.
WITH feature_ranked AS (
  SELECT borrower_id,history_months,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY borrower_id ORDER BY borrower_id) AS rn
  FROM borrower_features
),
outcome_ranked AS (
  SELECT borrower_id,bad_6m,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY borrower_id ORDER BY borrower_id) AS rn
  FROM borrower_outcomes
),
borrower_base AS (
  SELECT f.borrower_id,f.history_months,o.bad_6m
  FROM feature_ranked f
  JOIN outcome_ranked o ON o.borrower_id=f.borrower_id AND o.rn=1
  WHERE f.rn=1
),
segmented AS (
  SELECT borrower_id,bad_6m,
         CASE WHEN history_months<36 THEN '01 12-35 months'
              WHEN history_months<84 THEN '02 36-83 months'
              ELSE '03 84+ months' END AS segment
  FROM borrower_base
)
SELECT segment,COUNT(*) AS borrowers,SUM(bad_6m) AS events,
       ROUND(AVG(bad_6m),5) AS observed_rate
FROM segmented
GROUP BY segment
ORDER BY segment;
09_analytical_mart:
-- One row per synthetic borrower. No employer data. Feature cutoff is enforced by the view.
WITH product AS (
 SELECT borrower_id, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT product)>1 THEN 'Mixed products'
 WHEN MIN(product)='card' THEN 'Card only' ELSE 'Personal only' END AS product_group
 FROM accounts GROUP BY borrower_id
)
SELECT f.*, p.split, p.pd, p.bad_6m, product.product_group
FROM borrower_features f JOIN predictions p USING(borrower_id)
JOIN product USING(borrower_id) ORDER BY f.borrower_id;
10_threshold_sweep:
-- Saved held-out test results; exploratory thresholds, not lending policy.
WITH RECURSIVE thresholds(t) AS (SELECT 0 UNION ALL SELECT t+5 FROM thresholds WHERE t<100)
SELECT t/100.0 AS threshold, COUNT(*) AS borrowers,
 SUM(pd>=t/100.0 AND bad_6m=1) AS true_positive,
 SUM(pd>=t/100.0 AND bad_6m=0) AS false_positive,
 SUM(pd<t/100.0 AND bad_6m=1) AS false_negative,
 SUM(pd<t/100.0 AND bad_6m=0) AS true_negative,
 1.0*SUM(pd>=t/100.0 AND bad_6m=1)/NULLIF(SUM(pd>=t/100.0),0) AS precision,
 1.0*SUM(pd>=t/100.0 AND bad_6m=1)/NULLIF(SUM(bad_6m),0) AS recall
FROM thresholds CROSS JOIN predictions WHERE split='test' GROUP BY t ORDER BY t;
11_probability_distribution:
-- Full train/validation/test distributions: random cohort shift, NOT time drift.
WITH RECURSIVE bins(b) AS (SELECT 0 UNION ALL SELECT b+1 FROM bins WHERE b<9),
splits(s) AS (SELECT 'train' UNION ALL SELECT 'validation' UNION ALL SELECT 'test')
SELECT s AS split,b AS bin,b/10.0 AS lower_bound,(b+1)/10.0 AS upper_bound,
 COUNT(p.borrower_id) AS borrowers
FROM splits CROSS JOIN bins LEFT JOIN predictions p
ON p.split=s AND MIN(9,CAST(p.pd*10 AS INTEGER))=b
GROUP BY s,b ORDER BY s,b;
12_exposure_by_risk:
-- FAN-OUT CONTROL: deduplicate prediction and feature sources before borrower-level join.
WITH prediction_ranked AS (
  SELECT borrower_id,split,pd,bad_6m,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY split,borrower_id ORDER BY borrower_id) AS rn
  FROM predictions
),
feature_ranked AS (
  SELECT borrower_id,exposure,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY borrower_id ORDER BY borrower_id) AS rn
  FROM borrower_features
),
borrower_base AS (
  SELECT p.borrower_id,p.split,p.pd,p.bad_6m,f.exposure
  FROM prediction_ranked p
  JOIN feature_ranked f ON f.borrower_id=p.borrower_id AND f.rn=1
  WHERE p.rn=1
),
banded AS (
  SELECT *,
         CASE WHEN pd<.1 THEN '00-10%' WHEN pd<.2 THEN '10-20%'
              WHEN pd<.3 THEN '20-30%' WHEN pd<.5 THEN '30-50%'
              ELSE '50-100%' END AS probability_band
  FROM borrower_base
)
SELECT split,probability_band,COUNT(*) AS borrowers,
       ROUND(SUM(exposure),2) AS exposure_egp,
       AVG(pd) AS mean_probability,
       AVG(bad_6m) AS observed_event_rate
FROM banded
GROUP BY split,probability_band
ORDER BY split,probability_band;
13_monthly_quality:
-- Data-quality checks at source grain. Complete artificial history is intentional.
SELECT month_end,COUNT(*) AS account_rows,COUNT(DISTINCT account_id) AS unique_accounts,
 SUM(balance IS NULL OR payment_due IS NULL OR payment_paid IS NULL OR dpd IS NULL) AS null_rows,
 SUM(payment_paid>payment_due OR payment_paid<0 OR balance<0) AS invalid_amount_rows,
 SUM(dpd<0 OR dpd>180) AS invalid_dpd_rows
FROM monthly_snapshots GROUP BY month_end ORDER BY month_end;
14_training_woe_counts:
-- GRAIN CONTRACT: training-only borrower counts with duplicate guards on both sources.
WITH feature_ranked AS (
  SELECT borrower_id,utilization,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY borrower_id ORDER BY borrower_id) AS rn
  FROM borrower_features
),
prediction_ranked AS (
  SELECT borrower_id,bad_6m,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY split,borrower_id ORDER BY borrower_id) AS rn
  FROM predictions
  WHERE split='train'
),
train_base AS (
  SELECT f.borrower_id,f.utilization,p.bad_6m
  FROM feature_ranked f
  JOIN prediction_ranked p ON p.borrower_id=f.borrower_id AND p.rn=1
  WHERE f.rn=1
)
SELECT MIN(4,CAST(utilization*5 AS INTEGER)) AS utilization_bin,
       COUNT(*) AS borrowers,
       SUM(bad_6m=0) AS non_events,
       SUM(bad_6m=1) AS events
FROM train_base
GROUP BY utilization_bin
ORDER BY utilization_bin;
